zh-CN.intro: 这次更新重点改善 Subagent、长任务性能和跨设备连续性。你可以更清楚地看到工作如何推进，大型任务切换更快，重要名称和状态也不会在重启后丢失。

topics.title: Subagent 工作区与计划收口
topics.text: 新增持久化的 Subagent 工作区，并在右侧悬浮栏提供直接入口。每个 Subagent 的过程和结果都可以回看；未完成的旧计划也会在继续工作前自动对账。

topics.title: 大型任务更轻快
topics.text: 长任务只渲染当前需要查看的内容，切换时先显示界面再平滑载入消息。历史内容很多时，滚动和发送新消息会更流畅。

topics.title: 审查与远程工作
topics.text: 审查面板现在可以安全查看 SSH 或其他设备上的代码变化。生成文件识别更加准确，大批量文件处理也更快。

topics.title: iOS Simulator 接入
topics.text: 桌面端加入内嵌 iOS Simulator 查看器和连接能力，配合官方插件后，可以在 Mira 内查看并操作模拟器。

topics.title: 插件安装与更新更可靠
topics.text: 插件来源、权限确认和更新过程更加清楚。应用更新前会等待正在运行的插件安全退出，减少安装失败或重复进程。

topics.title: 设备、项目名称与 Art 结果不再丢失
topics.text: 远程设备会稳定保留身份和用户设置的名称；侧栏项目改名会及时保存；Art 现在可以正常展示由临时地址返回的生成图片。

topics.title: 多端与系统稳定性
topics.text: 手机端内容更新改善断线重连、离线发送和 Android 宽屏显示；无需重新安装移动端。修复 Windows 登录返回与退出问题。界面语言集中为简体中文和英文，减少未完整翻译造成的不一致。

en.intro: This update focuses on Subagents, long-task performance, and continuity across devices. It is easier to follow how work progresses, faster to switch into large tasks, and important names and states now survive restarts.

topics.title: Subagent workspace and plan follow-through
topics.text: A persistent Subagent workspace now has a direct entry in the floating toolbar on the right. You can revisit each Subagent's process and result, and unfinished plans are reconciled before work continues.

topics.title: Large tasks feel faster
topics.text: Long tasks render only what you are currently viewing, and the interface appears before messages load smoothly. Scrolling and sending new messages stay responsive even with a long history.

topics.title: Review and remote work
topics.text: The review panel can now safely show code changes over SSH or from another device. Generated files are identified more accurately and large file sets are handled faster.

topics.title: iOS Simulator integration
topics.text: The desktop app now includes an embedded iOS Simulator viewer and connection support. With the official plugin, you can view and operate the simulator inside Mira.

topics.title: More reliable plugin installs and updates
topics.text: Plugin sources, permission confirmation, and update progress are clearer. Before an app update, Mira waits for running plugins to stop safely, reducing failed installs and duplicate processes.

topics.title: Device names, project names, and Art results stay put
topics.text: Remote devices keep their identity and user-assigned names, sidebar project renames are saved promptly, and Art can now display generated images returned through temporary URLs.

topics.title: Cross-device and system stability
topics.text: A mobile content update improves reconnection, offline sending, and Android wide-screen layouts without requiring a mobile reinstall. Windows sign-in return and quit issues are fixed, and the interface now focuses on Simplified Chinese and English to avoid incomplete translations.
